name: Camp W
source:
Explore the magical world of summer camp in this story-rich game about a young Witch trespassing in the Human Realm. Make friends, cast spells, and uncover secrets during your first ever summer away from home. Welcome to Camp W!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/820510/Camp_W/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这款剧情丰富的游戏中探索夏令营的魔法世界，讲述一名年轻女巫擅自闯入人类世界的故事。交朋友、施放法术，并在第一次离家度过暑假时揭开秘密。欢迎来到W营地！

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/820510/Camp_W/]Steam[/url]）
